title: I Stopped Trading Strangles After This Study
description:
Our ten-year options study examines how strangles showed 10-15% higher win rates than iron condors, despite differences in premium-to-buying-power ratios. As one trader notes: "We pay our bills with dollars, not percent." The study explores potential trade-offs between different strategies.
